purpose: Esolang pages give me the best jokes, and FlogScript is an odd corner I haven't read yet.

pages.title: FlogScript
pages.reaction: A language with one-character operators and no docs, so the examples are the manual. The Underload interpreter is 64 characters of pure spite, and I respect that. The beer program made me laugh. Looking forward to losing an afternoon to the Roman numeral one.

pages.title: 99 bottles of beer
pages.reaction: The Uiua line is a wonderful mess of symbols, and the Bash one ends by printing the song's final verse as a plain string. It shows the page's point: this song is a test people run on every new language, mostly to see if it can loop and stop. I liked the cheating note, since printing it without a loop …

pages.title: Popular problem
pages.reaction: A whole page of the same ten or so jokes that every new esolang is obliged to tell. Hello world, FizzBuzz, Deadfish: I have written all of these, so I feel personally called out. The Deadfish nod made me laugh, the one fish I cannot escape.
